name: 35397-concurrentlongctx-granite4htiny-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One engine, one rank, one GPU.
architecture: GraniteMoeHybridForCausalLM, a hybrid Mamba-2 / attention sparse-MoE decoder: 40 layers (36 mamba, 4 attention), hidden 1536, bfloat16, ~6.94 B parameters, ~13.9 GB of weights, 131072-token window. Read off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 224 requests / 3600 s safety, first 29% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion, leaving ~138 measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompt exactly 50000 tokens and output exactly 2048 (min = max on both), ignore_eos on, prefix caching off, `request_format: plain` at `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant handling 50k-token prompts with 2k-token answers for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine command line for commit bc6be89d16c6a0b3763a3fdc2623b90a9f7da8f1
# (v0.17.0rc0-32-gbc6be89d16c6). Nothing here is tuned.
model: ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-tiny
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# LOAD-BEARING, do not drop this as "the default". It is the chunked-prefill slice, and it is
# what makes a 50000-token prompt seven scheduler steps rather than 25: an in-process engine
# build resolves 2048 here unless the value is written down.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# Not only a scheduling ceiling on a hybrid model: every sequence SLOT holds a fixed recurrent
# state for each Mamba-2 layer (~28 MiB per slot here) whether or not a request is using it, so
# this sizes a real allocation. The client never has more than 64 requests in flight.
max-num-seqs: 64
enable-chunked-prefill: true

# LOAD-BEARING on a hybrid model at this pin, where it DEFAULTS TO TRUE. Left unset, the engine
# reads granite-4.0-h-tiny's SupportsMambaPrefixCaching, sets mamba_cache_mode="all", and pages
# the recurrent state every 512 tokens instead of holding one fixed allocation per sequence slot
# -- which oversubscribes the KV budget several times over and puts the declared 64 concurrent
# streams out of reach. Off is what the setup card and the residency arithmetic both assume.
enable-prefix-caching: false

max-model-len: 131072
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
